name: Narrows Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234510: RV sites are Upper 001-006 only (lower loop tent), no water tags, no site photos. Esri 0.22 m/px: Poudre 15-20 m wide at the sites, under 30 m. West-side spur ends (inferred 003/005/006) 15-24 m from water through thin riparian brush; gallery photo shows tables with river just behind. On-water by distance, creek by size.

name: Paonia State Park
evidence: cpwshop 50034: Spruce 012/013 (25 ft) ~10 m from Muddy Creek (Esri 0.14 m/px, ~10-20 m wide, under 30 m); CPW: right next to a stream. Stored North Fork claim wrong; that river starts below the dam. Lakefront tags 007-009 are 20-ft sites. 006 (35 ft) tag unconfirmed: 15-20 m to high-water edge through willows, 25-33 m to channel, photo shows no water.

name: North Sterling State Park (Inlet Grove & Chimney View)
evidence: cpwshop 50065 Lakefront tags on electric drive-in sites (58-97 ft). Esri 0.18 m/px: west-row pads incl. 116/117 sit 13-20 m over open unused grass from the high-water bank of the drawn-down lake; DEM bank only ~2-3 m, no bluff. Site 116 photo: open apron straight to water. South-row 119-127 photos show a cottonwood belt at the inlet and do not earn it.

name: Oh Be Joyful Campground (Slate River)
evidence: rec.gov 10040591: site 1 (ML 42, RV) tagged Riverfront; pin 13-17 m from gravel/channel, site 1 panorama shows gravel bar behind the table. Slate River: Esri band ~25 m incl. bars, gallery photo shows ~10-15 m of water, under 30 m. Sites 2/3 ~35 m; 12/13/15 photos show no river; 7-10, 20-30 walk-to; 4, 6 under 23 ft. Only site 1 earns it.

name: One Mile Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232156 pins + Esri 0.4 m/px: every site is south of Taylor Canyon Road (CR 742); nearest (012, 016, 017) 60+ m from Taylor River, with the road and a tree belt between. No water tags; no site or facility photos on rec.gov. 'On the banks' is prose only. Closer frame: pads in pines, meadow then road toward river.

name: Ophir Creek Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10040622: no site coordinates or map, no water tags. Photos of RV sites 1-19 viewed: meadow, aspen, brush, boulders, no water visible. Esri frames at pin and facility coord: canopy and meadow, pads not legible, small riparian band to the east. Upgrade not earned; 'strung along Ophir Creek' is prose. Sites 20-31 tent-only, not viewed.

name: Outpost Motel, Cabins & RV Park
evidence: Campspot park map (SVG, schematic): 12 RV sites in two rows perpendicular to the Dolores, a cabin ending each row before the river. Esri 0.2 m/px: RVs seen ~30-35 m from water; brush belt, deck and river walk between. Site 10 photo: grass and table, no water; river photos are from the path. Dolores ~20 m wide. Campspot Waterfront tag is lead only.

name: Park Creek Campground
evidence: USFS page: 13 FCFS gravel sites, 35-ft spurs, 'many adjacent to the river'; not on rec.gov, no site photos exist. Esri 0.18 m/px: South Fork Rio Grande 14-18 m wide at the sites, under 30 m. South pad group near the toilet ~16-25 m from water across sparse trees and open ground; north pads 22-30 m. On-water by distance, creek by size.
